new_text: const t=f.target, low=(f.swoop&&f.swoop.st===3)||(t&&!t.dead&&!t.T.flying&&(f.engaged||gap(f,t)<=f.T.range+8));   // (a Dragon landing after its fire run)

old_text: Dragon fire run: every Dragon on the field when the battle starts flies off and comes in low and fast from beyond the enemy's edge, over the enemy's side to the middle of the field, turns and flies back out, then returns a moment later and fights as normal.
new_text: Dragon fire run: every Dragon on the field when the battle starts takes off from behind its own edge and flies low and very fast (6 times its flying speed) straight across the field, along the middle of the enemy army, and out past the enemy's edge. A moment later it comes back on from its own edge, glides down to land in front of its army and fights as normal.
